name: Regular hours
calc_basis: Hours x base rate on work date

name: Overtime 1.5x
calc_basis: OT hours x (base + 0.5 x regular rate)

name: Double time 2x
calc_basis: DT hours x (base + 1.0 x regular rate)

name: NGHT shift differential
calc_basis: $2.50 x NGHT hours outside night window

name: WKND shift differential
calc_basis: $1.00 x WKND hours outside night window

name: Child support
calc_basis: Order amount capped at limit of disposable earnings

name: Creditor garnishment
calc_basis: Flat with balance; CA creditor limit

name: 401(k) match
calc_basis: 100% of deferral up to 4% of gross

name: Accrued wages (biweekly Oct 18-31)
calc_basis: 2 weeks x scheduled hours x rate
